title: Mars Settlement
purpose: Establish a distant semi-autonomous industrial colony and recover the real Desh sample used by Lite Matter Engineering.
optimization_opportunities: Pre-build a compact startup package, establish robust power and local production, and avoid repeated Earth–Mars trips.
infrastructure_reuse: Earth, orbital, and lunar factories remain suppliers while Mars rapidly becomes locally productive.

milestones.title: Authorized Tier 2 Mars Launch
final_validation: Build a Tier 2 spacecraft and travel to Mars with mission authorization.

milestones.title: Martian Habitat
final_validation: Establish pressure, oxygen, water, radiation protection, communications, and safe habitation.

milestones.title: Reliable Martian Power
final_validation: Maintain local generation and storage through dust-related solar fluctuation; nuclear backup is encouraged.

milestones.title: Automated Martian Mining
final_validation: Mine and route Martian resources without direct labor.

milestones.title: Local Martian Manufacturing
final_validation: Process Martian materials and manufacture colony components locally.

milestones.title: Martian Desh Sample
final_validation: Obtain Galacticraft Desh (metadata 2), the existing real Mars Sample used by the Molecular Analyzer.

milestones.title: Martian Cargo and Return
final_validation: Establish a return or cargo route without relying on repeated emergency Earth supply trips.

milestones.title: Functional Martian Base
final_validation: Sustain habitat, water, power, communications, automated mining, local manufacturing, research readiness, and return capability.
milestones.temporary_validation: Manual-check the base until colony telemetry triggers exist.
